key_insight: Exact analysis links Jaynes–Cummings qubit fidelity to integrated coupling-noise correlations, with finite correlation times producing nonexponential decay and slower coherence loss than white noise.
engineering_relevance: The framework helps assess the robustness of cavity- and circuit-QED protocols against fluctuating qubit–cavity coupling, including stronger decoherence at higher photon numbers.
method: Model coupling fluctuations using Gaussian white noise and finite-memory Ornstein–Uhlenbeck noise.
Exploit closed dynamics within each excitation manifold to derive exact noise-averaged density matrices and fidelities.
Express fidelity through a single decoherence factor governed by integrated noise correlations.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports exact analytical results comparing noise models and identifying a crossover controlled by the noise correlation rate relative to coherent coupling strength; no experimental validation is described.
watch_item: Device-level predictions require checking whether the assumed noise models and single-mode dynamics capture the hardware’s dominant noise and loss channels.
paper_title: Fidelity Dynamics of a Jaynes--Cummings Qubit under Markovian and Non-Markovian Coupling Noise
